help.title: About Product variants
help.overview: A variant is one sellable SKU of a product. The cart and the till charge the variant price when a variant is selected. Only an active variant can be sold. The product is required.

sections.title: Price, identity, and stock
sections.body: Each variant stores its own SKU, barcode, price, compare-at price, cost, weight, and the attribute combination that identifies it. If the variant has no price, the product price is used.
items: Turn on track inventory when this SKU should be counted. Checkout then reserves that variant from a warehouse that holds it.
A line with no inventory row is treated as untracked and is not reserved.
An inactive variant is removed from the cart the next time the cart is priced.
